title: filter/emailpush: malformed before/after accepted and then match everything
description: validate.rs filter_ok never checks before/after; filter.rs:286-291 treats an unparseable bound as no constraint. {"before":"garbage"}, "2026-01-02", "2026-13-45T..Z", "+02:00" offsets all accepted; every Email then matches. RFC 8620 §1.4 UTCDate; -05 §4 invalid filter -> invalidProperties; Email/query -> invalidArguments. (probe-confirmed) (mail-server review 2026-11-19)
close_reason: Fixed with regression tests (tests/email_query_filter.rs, emailpush_validate.rs, emailpush_deliver.rs).
